# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 12 Camouflage widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger
# level-1..level-11 hybrid chassis baseline
# (tests/sd18_ranger_level11_quarry.rs, the SD18 loop's most recent Ranger
# ceiling) to Ranger level 12 as chosen input only. It names selections; it
# does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It is the level-11
# fixture with the class level bumped and NO additional chosen selections,
# since the 12th-level "Special" column entry, Camouflage (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com
# mirror: "A ranger of 12th level or higher can use the Stealth skill to
# hide, even while being observed, as long as she is within any sort of
# natural terrain that grants at least partial concealment or partial
# cover"), carries no player choice -- it is an unconditional grant, exactly
# like Woodland Stride and Swift Tracker before it.
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-11 fixture unchanged. No
# terrain-detection engine and no Stealth-check-execution engine exists in
# this codebase, so the fixture makes no such claim; only the grant identity
# is grounded.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level12-sd18-camouflage
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:12
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14

ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8

skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
